content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-227. - Release.
content.summary:
Upon payment of assessment or expiration of the reimbursement term, whichever occurs
               first, the city will, upon request, issue a written release to the owner of assessed
               property.
(Code 1981, § 27-187; Ord. No. 1721, § 7, 2-2-1981)
